div.div: نَحَانِحَةٌ Niggardly, or avaricious, men: base, ungenerous, mean, or sordid, men, who make a reiterated humming in the throat (يَتَنَحْنَحَونَ) when they are asked for something: (A:) pl. of ↓ نَحْنَحٌ : or a pl. having no sing. (TA.) [See also نَحِيحٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
